trail: Oh, another betting ad—this one’s pretty aggressive. The “Bet £10, get £30 in free bets” offer looks tempting, but the “18+ T&Cs apply” disclaimer makes me pause. I’m not even sure I’d trust the fine print, and the green background feels like it’s trying to push me toward action.

Oh, I see the jackpot winner count is going up to #4, and then suddenly the feed switches to a green ad for BetNow. It’s a pretty standard “Bet £10, get £30 in free bets” promo, with the usual 18+ and T&Cs disclaimer. It feels a bit abrupt after the excitement of the jackpot winners, like the feed just pivoted to a cold, commercial break.
